messages:
alana: Heads up — after rolling the new defaults last night (higher prefetch + max_new_tokens=1024) quokka11b int4 canaries spiked OOMs on the canary GPU pool. 😬
samir: ugh, saw the alerts. is this the same pattern as the warmstart frag we saw with vela?
sylvie: looks similar but smaller footprints. memory map shows a lot of short-lived KV allocations around token 350-420.
devin: can you paste the exact defaults we rolled?
alana: sure:
```
model_defaults:
  quokka11b:
    max_new_tokens: 1024
    prefetch_window: 32
    batch_timeout_ms: 12
```
marco: increasing prefetch_window to 32 might be overfetching for typical quokka prompts — it increases KV churn and pushes peak mem up.
samir: agree. latency benefits were marginal in canary. throughput looked better only for long-gen tests.
alana: we saw OOMs on generation length ~450 with bursts (many concurrent sessions). fallback to earlier defaults (max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=16) seemed to eliminate OOMs in smoke runs.
devin: any quality regressions when rolling back? we ran the short eval set — no meaningful delta on perplexity, but a slight increase in avg latency (~30ms).
sylvie: Quantization experiment note: quokka int4 has a small kv-alloc variance compared to int8; on top of prefetch it compounds fragmentation.
ops-bot: deploy #quokka11b-defaults-rollback started by alana — nodes: canary-*. ETA 10m. :construction:
marco: proposal: immediate rollback on host-level defaults for quokka11b, and add a canary-only mitigator that caps prefetch for concurrent sessions >8.
samir: +1. also suggest adding an automatic microbatch gating threshold when pending queue > 64.
devin: i'll open a quick PR with the rollback and a changelog entry. link in a mo.
alana: action items:
- devin: PR + rollback deploy (canary) — target: next 30m
- sylvie: run targeted memprof on canary with synthetic loads (vary gen len 100..800)
- marco: add policy to the routing layer to cap prefetch for high-concurrency sessions
- samir: add a quick eval for generation quality across 50 prompts to confirm no regressions post-rollback

marco: thinking longer term — we should have model-specific prefetched-KV heuristics based on typical seq-length histogram. can we log per-model seq hist and auto-tune?
sylvie: yes — we already collect seq hist at sample level, just need a small job to summarize daily and push a suggested profile. could prototype next week.
devin: PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/4521 - contains rollback + changelog + smoke job. deploying now.
alana: thanks — will monitor. if we still see OOMs after rollback we escalate and pin canary to an older model revision. :eyes:
ops-bot: deploy #quokka11b-defaults-rollback finished — canary success. :white_check_mark:
samir: good catch team. let's document the prefetch vs kv-frag interaction in the onboarding checklist for int4 models. small note for the future: prefetch_window is cheap for int8 but risky for int4.
alana: adding that to model-onboard/INT4_CHECKLIST.md. closing thread unless new alerts show up. :thumbsup:
